name: pocket-dj-web-app
description: Pocket DJ live remix deck for Pocket Chordsmith PCS1 songs and Pocket Audio performance handoffs.

scripts.test:cross-browser: playwright test tests/core-smoke.spec.js --project=firefox-desktop --project=webkit-desktop --grep "Pocket DJ exposes accessible|loads demo deck|deck controls queue"
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit --allowJs --checkJs --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext tests/scheduler-policy.test.mjs scripts/package-itch.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run test:scheduler && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run format:check && npm run report:size && npm run verify:single-file && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:cross-browser && npm run package:itch
